prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: visual-novel CG R0 layout keyframe
Primary request: Create the first composition/blocking draft for CG_003, the prologue image establishing the night the tower sealed after the last evacuation ship left Gray Harbor. This is an R0 layout image: prioritize the tower-to-human scale, storm direction, harbor geography, seven core lights and narrative readability over surface detail or final lighting polish.
Input images: Image 1 is the authoritative hero turnaround; use only her back silhouette, long hair length, mantle construction and adult proportions. Image 2 is the authoritative hero equipment/detail board; preserve only visible rear outfit construction, left-waist scabbard and flat record pouch. Image 3 is the expression board for identity only because her face is not visible. Image 4 is the transparent standee for scale and silhouette. Image 5 is the accepted night-tower environment reference ONLY for gothic architectural language, obsidian/navy stone, restrained gold trim, cold blue magical light and series cel-shaded rendering; do not copy its interior throne-room layout.
Scene/backdrop: Exterior Gray Harbor at night. A monumental sealed obsidian lighthouse-tower rises from the harbor breakwater. The sea and wet stone quay occupy the foreground, distant low harbor roofs sit along the sides, and a single last evacuation ship is already moving toward the far left horizon. A dense magical storm front approaches from the open sea on frame right.
Subject: The sealed tower is the dominant subject. The heroine is a very small adult back-facing foreground witness on the lower-left quay, looking up at the tower. Preserve her long midnight-blue hair with cobalt tips, navy-and-ivory mantle silhouette, symmetric navy boots, plain navy scabbard and flat black record pouch at her left waist. Her face is not visible.
Tower facts: The tower gate at the base has just sealed shut. Show exactly seven faint, restrained blue-violet core lights spaced vertically within the tower facade; they are small architectural signals, not giant floating orbs. The tower was meant to guide the evacuation ship, so its high beacon is present but muted and ominous.
Composition/framing: 16:9 cinematic ultra-wide establishing shot from a low quay viewpoint. Tower occupies the central vertical mass and about two thirds of image height. Hero remains under 10 percent of frame height on the lower-left third. Last ship is small on far-left water. Storm front presses in from right, creating a strong diagonal toward the tower. Keep the lower 22 percent comparatively low-detail for optional visual-novel UI without hiding the hero.
Emotional direction: The harbor is not celebrating survival; it witnesses an unresolved closure. Awe, abandonment and a sealed mystery.
Style/medium: Japanese 2D anime cel-shaded visual novel art, shoujo Galgame aesthetic; clean simple linework, broad flat color shapes, restrained two-step cel shading, soft atmospheric depth, controlled highlights, low visual noise, gentle edges, cinematic but readable composition. Treat this as a clean layout keyframe with simplified secondary architecture and restrained finish.
Lighting/mood: Moonless cold navy night, wet reflections, distant pale ship light, subtle blue-violet core lights, storm clouds darker at frame right. No orange festival lighting.
Constraints: Exterior harbor only. Exactly one tiny back-facing heroine. Exactly one distant evacuation ship. Exactly seven faint core lights on the tower facade. Gate visibly sealed. Tower must dominate. Follow source-grounded geography over the interior environment reference.
Avoid: interior throne hall, large hero portrait, front-facing hero, additional people, multiple ships, celebration, fireworks, readable signs, modern skyline, cars, text, HUD, logo, watermark, giant glowing orbs, excessive lightning, photorealism, 3D rendering, painterly microtexture, cluttered debris.
